nodes.label: MatterChat: Multimodal LLM for Materials Science
nodes.author: Tang, Xu, Cao, Gao et al.
nodes.rationale: Integrates material structure data (via graph encoders) with textual queries through bridge model; enables property prediction, structural analysis, and synthesis guidance; outperforms GPT-4, Gemini, DeepSeek on formation energy prediction.

nodes.label: Bridge Model (BLIP2-inspired)
nodes.rationale: Multilayer transformer with 32 trainable query vectors; cross-attention in even layers extracts features from atom embeddings, self-attention in odd layers enhances depth; refines embeddings to LLM-compatible format via linear projection.

nodes.label: Material Processing Branch (CHGNet/MACE)
nodes.rationale: Pretrained universal MLIP encoders (CHGNet or MACE) extract atom embeddings from material graphs; frozen weights preserve foundation model generalization; enables plug-and-play flexibility.

nodes.label: Language Processing Branch (Mistral 7B)
nodes.rationale: Processes user text prompts into dense embeddings; combined with query embeddings via structured fusion; enables precise context-relevant responses for material-related queries.

nodes.label: Multimodal RAG for Robustness
nodes.rationale: Retrieves 2 additional similar materials from training set via L2 similarity; aggregates results via majority voting (classification) or averaging (regression); reduces regression RMSE by ~12%, improves classification accuracy by ~0.6%.

nodes.label: Materials Project Trajectory Dataset (142,899 samples)
nodes.rationale: Curated from MPtrj relaxed structures; 12 tasks: 3 descriptive (formula, space group, crystal system) + 9 property prediction (metallicity, bandgap, stability, formation energy, etc.); 9:1 train/test split.

nodes.label: Two-Stage Training (Pretraining + Fine-tuning)
nodes.rationale: Pretraining: graph-text correlation (contrastive loss), graph-driven text prediction (CLM loss), graph-text association (BCE loss). Fine-tuning: supervised cross-entropy on 12 multimodal subtasks; ~48h on 8 A100 nodes.

nodes.label: Structural Embedding Analysis (UMAP + SOAP)
nodes.rationale: UMAP reduces 4096-dim embeddings to 2D; SOAP descriptor + REMatch kernel compute structural similarity; reveals clustering by composition, structure, and formation energy; demonstrates model captures structure-property information.
